<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,7,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Andra!
We found a strange constellation,
so we came to report!

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,2>Oh, you found it?
Let's see, what was it...

<TALK 1><NAME 1>Yes!
The nebulae overlapped
and looked like a dragon with spread wings.

A dragon of stars dancing in the night sky,
a fantastical scene.

<TALK 5><NAME 10>Hmm...
a dragon floating in the night sky, curious.

One might call it the Dragon Nebula...
This is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>You did it, Hunter!
A huge discovery!
